_comment: Single source of truth for the fictional product. Every corpus document is authored against this file, and eval/gold.json answer keys reference it. When a fact differs by version, the `by_version` map is canonical and any document stating a bare value must belong to the matching era.

timeout_zero_semantics.canonical: fail-fast: the job fails immediately on the first attempt
timeout_zero_semantics.common_misconception: that timeout=0 disables the timeout (it does not)

enqueue_api.deprecated_status: still functional in 3.2, emits DeprecationWarning, slated for removal in 4.0

dlq.entry_condition: a job enters the dead-letter queue after max_retries attempts are exhausted
dlq.replay: manual only, via `zephyr dlq replay <job-id>` or client.dlq.replay()
dlq.undocumented_flag: --include-payload (documented only in a staff forum post)

rate_limits.documented_behavior: the SDK honours Retry-After and schedules the next attempt accordingly
rate_limits.observed_bug: in 3.0 the SDK ignored Retry-After and applied plain exponential backoff; fixed in 3.1

by_version.3.0: broken (symlink resolution bug in the credential store)

default_worker_concurrency.note: Managed workers default to 10. Self-hosted agents default to CPU count; this is a different component, not a contradiction.

legacy_ack_flag.note: The CLI reference page still documents it (stale); the changelog is correct.
